shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a green shirt sits at the sideboard-side window seat and asks about preferences for afternoon tea, while a woman in an orange shirt sits at the patio-side window seat, a woman in a white shirt sits at the sideboard-side aisle seat, and a man in a blue shirt sits at the patio-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the patio doors end, looking along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the sideboard in frame.

shots.content: The man in the green shirt and the woman in the orange shirt exchange seats, and he asks whether sugar is preferred.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in the orange shirt states a strict preference against sugar.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the sideboard-side window seat.

shots.content: The man in the green shirt replies that sugar will be served anyway.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the dining table.
